batched_iterable: batch an iterable into chunks of size n, returning lists instead of tuples
test_batched_function: test the batched function with a string and chunk size of 3
refactor_batched_function: refactor the batched function to support an optional start parameter
review_batched_function: review the batched function for edge cases like empty iterables and n less than one
summarize_batched_function: summarize the batched function that splits an iterable into fixed-size batches
